feature.title: Their product. Our platform.
feature.body: Dion's Chicago Dream moves 325,000 pounds of fresh produce each month to more than 5,400 households a week, across every Chicago neighborhood. Together, Veranda and Dion's Chicago Dream created DreamBox to cover the last few feet of that journey. It runs on battery over long-range wireless, with no power, Wi-Fi, or installer, keeping food fresh, opening only for an authorized carrier, and flagging anything out of the ordinary.

points.title: The challenge
points.body: Fresh food arrives on a schedule, but the households receiving it often can't be home to meet it. A doorstep drop risks spoilage and theft; a missed one means another trip.

points.title: How it fits
points.body: The Dream Box slots into the program's existing routes. Carriers are verified automatically, and the program sees what has arrived, its condition, and who has access.

points.title: Intended value
points.body: For the organization: fewer failed drops and less waste. For households: fresh food that's there when they get home, closing the gap between a meal grown and a meal received.
